title: run_post_pipeline checks .code \!= 240 instead of using Result — fragile success check
description: lifecycle.rs run_post_pipeline: 'let validation = complete_post(...); if validation.code \!= 240 { return validation; }'. complete_post() returns a Response directly instead of Result. If complete_post ever returns a different 2xx code for success (e.g., 200 for a valid article on a read-only server), the check silently rejects valid articles. Any future refactor that adds a new success case is forced to remember this check or break silently. Scenario: contributor adds a new complete_post return path for accepted-but-redirect, uses code 203, articles rejected with no warning. Fix: change complete_post to return Result<(), Response> so the type system enforces success/failure.
